Cats don't hibernate, but Spring Herald believes she's a special one.
As winter approaches, she acts like a bear, scavenging for materials to build her nest.
She carries a few fruits, pushes some wheat ears, and meows at humans until she finds a cozy straw nest under their eaves.
When thirsty, she nibbles on fruits; when hungry, she munches on wheat ears. And when craving a treat, a meow brings dried Xiao Yu right to her straw nest.
Every winter, Spring Herald lazily spends her days this way.
When the first spring bud breaks through the winter chill, its fragrance reaches her nose before anyone else's.
Meow! Meow! Her loud cries make people chuckle.
Spring has arrived.
